etymology_story.zh: 这是苏格兰英语中由 dud 加 -y 形成的形容词；dud 及其复数 duds 曾表示衣服，尤其是破衣服。由“破衣服”自然发展出“衣衫褴褛的、破旧的”之义。
etymology_story.en: This Scots adjective was formed from dud with the suffix -y; dud and its plural duds referred to clothing, especially ragged clothing. The adjective therefore developed the meaning of wearing rags or being shabby.

morphology_enriched.zh: dud（衣服；破衣服）+ -y → duddy，加后缀时双写末尾的 d；比较级 duddier，最高级 duddiest。相关词有 dud 和 duds；现代英语 dud 的“废物、失败品”义与该方言形容词的衣着义应分开辨认。
morphology_enriched.en: Dud, meaning clothing or a ragged garment, combines with -y to form duddy, doubling the final d; the comparative and superlative are duddier and duddiest. Related forms include dud and duds; the modern 'failure or useless thing' sense of dud should be distinguished from the clothing sense underlying this Scots adjective.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: ragged 强调衣物破裂、磨损或边缘不整；shabby 强调因使用过久而显得破旧；threadbare 强调布料磨得很薄，甚至露出织线。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Ragged emphasizes tears, wear, or uneven edges; shabby emphasizes a worn and neglected appearance; threadbare specifically suggests fabric worn so thin that its threads show.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: duds 是衣服：duddy 就是穿着破衣服的样子。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Duds are clothes: picture duddy as dressed in worn-out duds.

morphology.text: round + head → Roundhead，字面是“圆头”，在英国内战语境中指圆颅党人。

etymology.text: 17世纪英语用 round 和 head 组合成这一称呼；议会派清教徒常剪短发，头形显得圆，与保王党人的长发形成对照。

etymology_story.zh: Roundhead 由 round（圆的）和 head（头）组成，17世纪初成为对英国内战议会派的嘲称。这个称呼影射部分清教徒的短发造型，与当时一些保王党人的长发形成对照，并非所有议会派成员都留短发。
etymology_story.en: Roundhead combines round and head and became a mocking name for Parliament's supporters in the seventeenth century. It referred to the closely cropped hair of some Puritans, contrasted with the longer hairstyles of some Royalists, although not all Parliamentarians wore their hair short.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：round（圆的）+ head（头）→ Roundhead，是复合词，没有派生词缀。名词复数为 Roundheads；同形形容词为 Roundhead；相关普通形容词 round-headed 表示“圆头的”，不必然具有政治含义。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: round + head → Roundhead, a compound without derivational affixes. The noun plural is Roundheads, and the adjective has the same form, Roundhead; the related ordinary adjective round-headed means having a round head and does not necessarily carry the historical political meaning.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Parliamentarian（议会派成员）是较中性的对应称呼；Puritan（清教徒）强调宗教身份，与圆颅党人有重合但不等同；republican（共和主义者）强调反对君主制，而议会派并非人人最初都主张共和。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Parliamentarian is the closest neutral equivalent; Puritan describes a religious identity that overlapped with Roundhead allegiance; republican describes opposition to monarchy, a position not initially shared by every Parliamentarian.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: round + head：短发显出“圆头”，由发型绰号记住议会派。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Round + head: closely cropped hair reveals a rounded head, linking the hairstyle nickname to Parliament's supporters.

etymology_story.zh: blackwater 由 black（黑的）与 water（水）合成，字面意思是“黑水”。这一描述性组合在不同专业语境中分别用于指厕所污水，以及被植物有机物染深的天然水体。
etymology_story.en: Blackwater is a compound of black and water, literally meaning dark water. The descriptive combination developed distinct technical uses for toilet wastewater and for natural waters darkened by organic substances from vegetation.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：black（黑的）+ water（水）→ blackwater，无派生词缀，通常作不可数名词，没有常用的派生词族。blackwater treatment（黑水处理）和 blackwater river（黑水河）中的 blackwater 都作名词定语；相关词 greywater/graywater（灰水）通常指不含厕所排水的生活污水。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: black + water → blackwater, with no derivational affixes; it is usually an uncountable noun and has no common derivative family. In blackwater treatment and blackwater river, blackwater modifies another noun; the related term greywater/graywater generally means household wastewater excluding toilet discharge.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: sewage（污水、下水道污物）通常指包含人类排泄物的污水，范围可比厕所黑水更广；wastewater（废水）是上位词，也包括其他生活和工业排水；tannin-stained water（被单宁染色的水）可描述天然黑水，但不指厕所污水。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Sewage usually includes human waste but can cover more than toilet discharge; wastewater is the broader category covering domestic and industrial waste liquids; tannin-stained water describes natural blackwater rather than toilet effluent.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: black + water＝黑水：看到厕所想到污水，看到河流想到植物染深的水。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Black + water: toilets suggest waste; rivers suggest water darkened by plant matter.

morphology.text: Tet 作为独立词素整体记忆；pre- + Tet → pre-Tet，表示“越南春节前的”，pre- 表示“在……之前”。

etymology.text: 英语直接借用越南语 tết，指越南农历新年；可联想家人团聚迎接新年的场景。

usage_note: 节日名称首字母大写，通常说 during Tet 或 celebrate Tet。不是所有国家的农历新年都叫 Tet。

senses.english_definition: Tet is the Vietnamese Lunar New Year festival, when people traditionally celebrate with their families and honour their ancestors.

etymology_story.zh: 英语 Tet 借自越南语 Tết，是 Tết Nguyên Đán（越南春节）的简称。Tết 与汉越词 tiết（对应汉字“节”，表示节令、节日）同源，体现了名称从节令概念到特指新年节庆的演变。
etymology_story.en: English Tet comes from Vietnamese Tết, short for Tết Nguyên Đán, the Vietnamese Lunar New Year. Tết is historically related to Sino-Vietnamese tiết, corresponding to Chinese 節 and referring to a seasonal division or festival, with the shortened name becoming especially associated with New Year.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 Tet 是整体借入的专有名词，不能拆成有意义的英语词根和词缀，也没有常用派生词族。pre-Tet（越南春节前的）和 post-Tet（越南春节后的）是以 pre-（在……之前）和 post-（在……之后）构成的临时修饰语；Tet celebrations（越南春节庆祝活动）是名词短语。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, Tet is a borrowed proper noun with no meaningful English root-and-affix division and no common derivative family. Pre-Tet and post-Tet are transparent modifiers formed with pre-, meaning before, and post-, meaning after; Tet celebrations is a noun phrase.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Vietnamese New Year（越南新年）是最直接的英语对应表达；Vietnamese Lunar New Year（越南农历新年）进一步明确历法；Lunar New Year（农历新年）范围更广，也可指其他文化中的新年庆典。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Vietnamese New Year is the most direct English equivalent; Vietnamese Lunar New Year makes the calendar reference explicit; Lunar New Year is broader and also covers celebrations in other cultures.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: Tết 联系“节”：越南最重要的团圆年节，就是 Tet。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Connect Tết with the idea of a festival: Vietnam's major family New Year celebration is Tet.

morphology.text: Canopus 作为独立词素整体记忆；Canopus + tracker → Canopus tracker，组成“老人星跟踪器”这一设备名称。

etymology.text: 英语经拉丁语 Canopus 借自希腊语 Kanōpos；这一古老名称被用于今天的老人星。

etymology_story.zh: Canopus 经拉丁语传入英语，可追溯到古希腊语 Kanōbos，也写作 Kanōpos。这个古老名称与埃及的卡诺普斯城及传说中墨涅拉俄斯的舵手有关，但星名的最终来源并不确定。
etymology_story.en: Canopus reached English through Latin and goes back to Greek Kanōbos, also written Kanōpos. The ancient name is associated with the Egyptian city of Canopus and the legendary helmsman of Menelaus, although the ultimate origin of the star's name is uncertain.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 Canopus 是整体借入的专有名词，不能按英语词根和词缀进行有效拆分，也没有常用的恒星名称派生词族。Canopus tracker（老人星跟踪器）由专名 Canopus 与名词 tracker（跟踪器）组成，是短语而非派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, Canopus is a borrowed proper noun without a productive English root-and-affix analysis or a common derivative family referring to the star. Canopus tracker combines the proper name with the noun tracker and is a phrase rather than a derived word.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Alpha Carinae（船底座α星）是老人星的拜耳命名，α Car 是这一名称的标准缩写；两者与 Canopus 指同一颗恒星，属于正式名称和缩写，而不是具有不同语义色彩的普通近义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Alpha Carinae is the star's Bayer designation, and α Car is its standard abbreviation. Both identify the same star as Canopus; they are alternative designations rather than ordinary synonyms with different shades of meaning.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 古代“舵手”之名，现代航天定向之星：Canopus＝老人星。
mnemonic_anchor.en: An ancient helmsman's name, a modern spacecraft's guide: Canopus is the bright navigation star.

meaning: 跗部（足与小腿之间的部位）

pronunciation.note: 采用美式读音；将词典发音符号转写为 IPA。

forms: 可数名词；复数 tarsi。
family: tarsal 跗部的；metatarsus 跖部。

morphology.text: tarsus 作为独立词素整体记忆；tars- + -al → tarsal，表示“跗部的”，派生时去掉 -us。

etymology.text: 英语经新拉丁语 tarsus 借自希腊语 tarsos，后者可指足底或踝部；它由此成为足部解剖名称。

usage_note: 解剖术语。本课学习足部的跗部义；tarsi 是不规则复数，不能写成 tarsuses。

etymology_story.zh: tarsus 经新拉丁语借自古希腊语 tarsos，后者可表示扁平的编织框架，也用于指足底等平展结构。医学和动物学沿用了这种“支撑性平面结构”的命名思路，将它用于跗部、某些动物的足部及眼睑的睑板。
etymology_story.en: Tarsus comes through New Latin from Greek tarsos, which could mean a flat wicker framework and was also used for the sole of the foot. Anatomical terminology extended this idea of a supporting framework to parts of the foot or leg and to the firm plate inside an eyelid.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语将 tarsus 作为完整的学术借词使用；古典复数是 tarsi。相关词干为 tars-，组合形式为 tarso-：tars- + -al → tarsal（跗部的；睑板的）；相关专业词族包括 tarsomere（昆虫跗分节）、pretarsus（前跗节）、tarsometatarsus（跗跖骨）、tarsometatarsal（跗跖部的）、tibiotarsus（胫跗骨）、tibiotarsal（胫跗部的）、tarsitis（睑板炎）和 tarsorrhaphy（睑缘缝合术）。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern English uses tarsus as a complete learned borrowing; its classical plural is tarsi. The related stem is tars-, with the combining form tarso-: tars- + -al → tarsal, meaning relating to the tarsus or an eyelid's tarsal plate. The technical family includes tarsomere, an insect tarsal segment; pretarsus, the terminal structure beyond the tarsus; tarsometatarsus and tarsometatarsal; tibiotarsus and tibiotarsal; tarsitis, inflammation of an eyelid's tarsal plate; and tarsorrhaphy, surgical joining of the eyelid margins.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: tarsal region（跗区）对应人足的区域含义；tarsal plate（睑板）对应眼睑含义；foot（足）在昆虫描述中可作通俗近似说法，但在人类解剖中范围大于 tarsus，因此这些表达不能跨语境互换。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Tarsal region corresponds to the human foot-region sense; tarsal plate corresponds to the eyelid sense; foot is a useful informal approximation in insect descriptions but covers more than the tarsus in human anatomy, so these expressions are not interchangeable across contexts.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 抓住“支撑框架”：足部有跗部，眼睑有睑板；tars- 指向这类支撑结构。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Think supporting framework: the foot has a tarsus, and the eyelid has a tarsal plate.

pronunciation.note: 采用美式读音；将词典发音符号转写为 IPA。

morphology.text: Baekeland（人名缩写变形）+ -ite → Bakelite；用发明者姓氏的一部分与材料名称后缀组成名称。

etymology.text: 20世纪初的英语商标名称，取自发明者 Leo H. Baekeland 的姓氏，并加上 -ite；可以把材料与发明者联系记忆。

senses.meaning_en: a hard, heat-resistant plastic made from phenol-formaldehyde resin

etymology_story.zh: Bakelite 是20世纪初创立的商标名称，由发明者 Leo Hendrik Baekeland 的姓氏改造后加上材料名称中常见的后缀 -ite 构成。这个名称后来广泛用于指称这类酚醛树脂塑料。
etymology_story.en: Bakelite originated as an early twentieth-century trademark formed from an adapted version of inventor Leo Hendrik Baekeland's surname and the material-name suffix -ite. The name subsequently became widely used for this type of phenol-formaldehyde plastic.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中通常把 Bakelite 作为整体材料名称使用；历史构词为 Baekeland 的姓氏变体 Bake- + -lite，其中包含材料名称后缀 -ite，不能把 bake 解释为表示“烘烤”的词根。本词没有常用的屈折变化或成熟的派生词族；Bakelite-based（以电木为基础的）和 Bakelite-handled（带电木手柄的）属于透明复合形式。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, Bakelite is normally treated as a whole material name. Historically, it combines an adapted form of Baekeland's surname with a formation containing the material-name suffix -ite; its apparent bake element does not mean 'cook in an oven.' It has no established common derivative family; Bakelite-based and Bakelite-handled are transparent compounds.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: phenolic plastic（酚醛塑料）是较宽泛的材料类别名称；phenol-formaldehyde resin（苯酚甲醛树脂）强调化学组成，也可指尚未制成成品的树脂。Bakelite 则是具有商标来源的特定材料名称，两者并非在所有语境中都可替换。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Phenolic plastic names a broader material category, while phenol-formaldehyde resin emphasizes chemical composition and can refer to resin before it becomes a finished article. Bakelite is a historically trademarked material name, so these terms are not interchangeable in every context.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: Baekeland 的名字 → Bakelite 电木 → 老式电器的坚硬耐热外壳。

etymology_story.zh: capercaillie 借自苏格兰盖尔语 capall-coille，字面意思是“森林之马”，其中 capall 表示“马”，coille 与“树林”有关。这一形象化名称用来称呼这种体型硕大的林鸟。
etymology_story.en: Capercaillie comes from Scottish Gaelic capall-coille, literally 'horse of the woods,' combining a word for 'horse' with a form referring to woodland. This vivid name refers to the bird's impressive size.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中为不可再按英语词根和词缀拆分的借词。复数可用 capercaillies，也可保持 capercaillie 不变；capercailzie 是另一种历史拼写。本词没有常用派生词族；capercaillie-watching（观察西方松鸡）是复合表达，不能视为原词内部的构词结构。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, this is a borrowed word without a productive English root-and-affix breakdown. Its plural can be capercaillies or unchanged capercaillie; capercailzie is an alternative historical spelling. It has no established common derivative family; capercaillie-watching is a compound expression rather than an internal analysis of the bird's name.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: western capercaillie（西方松鸡）是更明确的物种名称；wood grouse（林松鸡）是传统通称。grouse（松鸡）则是上位类别词，涵盖多种鸟，不能精确替代 capercaillie。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Western capercaillie is the more explicit species name, and wood grouse is a traditional common name. Grouse is the broader category covering several kinds of birds and is therefore less precise.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 盖尔语“森林之马” → 森林里体型特别大的松鸡。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Gaelic 'horse of the woods' → an exceptionally large forest grouse.

senses.meaning_zh: 花冠；一朵花全部花瓣的总称
senses.meaning_en: all the petals of a flower considered together
senses.english_definition: The corolla of a flower is the complete set of its petals, whether they are separate or joined together.

etymology_story.zh: corolla 作为植物学术语取自拉丁语 corolla，意为“小花环”或“小冠”，是 corona（花环；冠）的指小形式。这个名称把一朵花的整组花瓣比作一个小花环。
etymology_story.en: The botanical term corolla comes from Latin corolla, meaning 'small garland' or 'little crown,' a diminutive of corona, 'garland' or 'crown.' The name compares the flower's collective petals to a small wreath.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中以 corolla 为基本词，派生时常用词干 coroll-；复数为 corollas 或 corollae。植物学词族包括 coroll- + -ate → corollate（有花冠的）、coroll- + -aceous → corollaceous（花冠状的；花瓣状的）、coroll- + -ine → corolline（花冠的）、coroll- + -iform → corolliform（花冠状的）和 coroll- + -iferous → corolliferous（具花冠的）；这些派生词多限于专业语境。
morphology_enriched.en: Corolla is the modern base, with coroll- commonly used as the stem in derivatives; its plurals are corollas and corollae. Botanical relatives include corollate, 'having a corolla'; corollaceous, 'resembling a corolla or petals'; corolline, 'relating to the corolla'; corolliform, 'shaped like a corolla'; and corolliferous, 'bearing a corolla.' These derivatives are chiefly specialist terms.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: petals collectively（全部花瓣的合称）是最直接的解释性替换；petal whorl（花瓣轮）强调花瓣的轮状排列。perianth（花被）范围更大，通常包括花冠和花萼，不能当作严格同义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Petals collectively is the closest plain-language equivalent, while petal whorl emphasizes their arrangement. Perianth is broader, usually including both the corolla and the calyx, so it is not an exact synonym.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 小花环、小冠 → 花瓣围成的一整圈 → 花冠。
mnemonic_anchor.en: A little wreath or crown → the complete ring of petals → corolla.

etymology_story.zh: Emmental 得名于瑞士的埃门河谷，这一德语地名由河名 Emme 和表示“山谷”的 Tal 构成。产地名称后来成为这种奶酪及其同类风格奶酪的名称。
etymology_story.en: Emmental takes its name from Switzerland's Emme valley; the German place name combines Emme, the river name, with Tal, 'valley.' The place name became the name of the cheese and of cheeses made in the same style.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中通常把 Emmental 作为完整的地名来源食品名称使用；其德语内部结构为 Emme + 连接成分 -n- + Tal（山谷）。相关形式包括 Emmentaler（同类奶酪名称，包含德语地域关系后缀 -er），以及保留旧式 th 拼写的 Emmenthal、Emmenthaler；这些主要是相关名称或拼写变体，并非活跃的英语派生词族。

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Emmentaler（埃门塔尔奶酪）是对应的另一名称；Swiss cheese（瑞士式奶酪）在某些语境中指这种多孔奶酪，但范围更宽。Gruyère（格吕耶尔奶酪）是另一种瑞士奶酪，风味和孔洞特征不同，只是相关食品，并非同义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Emmentaler is an alternative name for the cheese. Swiss cheese can refer to this hole-filled style, but is broader and depends on context. Gruyère is a different Swiss cheese with different flavour and hole characteristics, so it is a related food rather than a synonym.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: Emme 河 + Tal 山谷 → 瑞士埃门河谷出产的多孔奶酪。

meaning: 链霉亲和素（一种能紧密结合生物素的蛋白质）

morphology.text: Streptomyces avidinii（菌名缩合成 streptavid-）+ -in（蛋白质名称后缀）→ streptavidin，链霉亲和素。

etymology.text: 这是现代英语生化名称，取自来源细菌的新拉丁语名称 Streptomyces avidinii，再加蛋白质名称常用的 -in；菌名留下了它的来源线索。

etymology_story.zh: streptavidin 的名称结合了其来源细菌 Streptomyces avidinii 的属名线索与 avidin（亲和素）这一蛋白质名称。它与亲和素一样能极强地结合生物素，但两者是不同的蛋白质。
etymology_story.en: The name streptavidin combines a reference to its bacterial source, Streptomyces avidinii, with avidin, the name of another biotin-binding protein. Like avidin, streptavidin binds biotin extremely strongly, but the two are distinct proteins.

morphology_enriched.zh: 可按科学命名结构理解为 strept-（截自 Streptomyces，链霉菌属）+ avidin（亲和素）；avidin 本身含 avid-（与“渴求、强烈趋向”有关）和蛋白质名称后缀 -in。不宜机械地把菌种全名缩成 streptavid- 再加 -in。本词没有常用的一般英语派生词族；streptavidin-coated（链霉亲和素包被的）和 streptavidin-conjugated（链霉亲和素偶联的）是常见技术复合形式。
morphology_enriched.en: Its scientific naming structure can be understood as strept-, shortened from Streptomyces, plus avidin. Avidin itself contains avid-, associated with eagerness or strong attraction, and the protein-name suffix -in. It should not simply be analysed as the entire bacterial species name compressed into streptavid- plus -in. There is no established general-English derivative family; streptavidin-coated and streptavidin-conjugated are common technical compounds.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 本词没有常用的严格同义词。biotin-binding protein（生物素结合蛋白）是上位名称；avidin（亲和素）通常指最初从蛋清中发现的另一种生物素结合糖蛋白；NeutrAvidin（中性亲和素）是经去糖基化处理的亲和素制品名称，不能与 streptavidin 混同。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: There is no common exact synonym. Biotin-binding protein is a broader category; avidin usually denotes a different biotin-binding glycoprotein originally identified in egg white; NeutrAvidin names a deglycosylated avidin preparation. Neither related protein should be confused with streptavidin.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 链霉菌来源 + 对生物素的强亲和力 → 链霉亲和素。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Streptomyces source + avid attraction to biotin → streptavidin.

senses.meaning_en: A person who selectively kills animals to manage a population.

etymology_story.zh: culler 由动词 cull 加施事后缀 -er 构成。cull 经中古英语及古法语中表示“采集、挑选”的词形，追溯至拉丁语 colligere“收集”；其含义后来发展为挑出并清除不需要的东西。
etymology_story.en: Culler is formed from the verb cull and the agent suffix -er. Cull came through Middle English and Old French forms meaning 'gather' or 'select', ultimately from Latin colligere 'collect', and developed the sense of selecting and removing unwanted things.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：cull（挑选并剔除）+ -er（执行者）→ culler。核心词族及屈折形式：cull、culls、culled、culling、culler、cullers；其中 culling 也可作名词，表示剔除或选择性捕杀。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern formation: cull 'select and remove' + -er 'person who performs an action' → culler. The core family and inflected forms are cull, culls, culled, culling, culler, and cullers; culling also functions as a noun for selective removal or killing.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: sorter（分拣员）侧重分类；grader（分级员）侧重按质量或规格定级；culler（剔选员）特别强调挑出并去除不合格或多余的个体。这些职业名称不能直接替换动物捕杀义的 culler。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: A sorter separates items into categories, while a grader assigns quality or size grades; a culler specifically selects and removes inferior or surplus individuals. Sorter and grader do not replace culler in its animal-control sense.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: cull 是“挑出并剔除”，-er 是“做这件事的人”：从挑坏果到控制动物数量，核心都是选择性去除。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Cull means 'select and remove'; -er names the person doing it. Removing bad fruit and controlling animal numbers share the idea of selective removal.

etymology.text: 19世纪末英语中已有这一复合词，把 back 与 chat 组合，用“回过去的话”表达顶嘴的语气。

usage_note: 非正式用语，在英式英语中常见。常说 give someone backchat；通常带不满语气。

senses.meaning_zh: 顶嘴；对长辈或上级无礼的回话，主要用于英式英语

senses.meaning_zh: 顶嘴；无礼地回话，主要用于英式英语
senses.meaning_en: To reply rudely to someone in authority, chiefly in British English.
senses.english_definition: If someone backchats, they answer a parent, teacher, or another person in authority in a rude or disrespectful way.
senses.collocation_en: backchat the teacher; stop backchatting
senses.collocation_zh: 跟老师顶嘴；停止顶嘴

etymology_story.zh: backchat 是由 back“回、反向”与 chat“闲谈、说话”组成的英语复合词，19世纪已有使用记录。“回过去的话”逐渐固定为对权威无礼回话的意思，随后也用作动词。
etymology_story.en: Backchat is an English compound of back and chat, recorded in the nineteenth century. The idea of words spoken back developed into the meaning of disrespectful replies to authority, and the word also came to be used as a verb.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：back（回、反向）+ chat（说话）→ backchat；名词可通过零派生用作动词。核心屈折形式：backchats、backchatted、backchatting；后两者需双写末尾的 t。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern formation: back 'in return' + chat 'talk' → backchat; the noun also functions as a verb through conversion. Core inflections are backchats, backchatted, and backchatting, with the final t doubled before -ed and -ing.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: backtalk（顶嘴）是主要用于美式英语的近义词；insolence（无礼、傲慢）范围更广，也包括行为和态度；repartee（机智应答）强调反应敏捷，通常不含冒犯权威的意思。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Backtalk is the chiefly American equivalent. Insolence includes disrespectful behaviour and attitudes as well as speech, while repartee means witty exchanges and need not involve disrespect.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: back + chat＝把话“顶回去”：记住不只是回答，而是带着无礼态度回嘴。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Back + chat means talking back: picture an answer pushed back with a disrespectful attitude.

meaning: 炎性淋巴结肿大（尤指腹股沟处）

etymology.text: 英语经中世纪拉丁语 bubo 借自希腊语 boubōn；这个医学名称一直保留了腹股沟及其肿块的含义线索。

usage_note: 专业医学名词。本课只识别术语含义；它指淋巴结的炎性肿大，不是普通皮肤擦伤的统称。

senses.meaning_zh: 腹股沟、腋窝或颈部等处因感染而肿痛的淋巴结；腹股沟淋巴结炎性肿块

senses.english_definition: A bubo is a swollen and often painful lymph node caused by an infection, especially one associated with bubonic plague.
senses.collocation_en: inguinal bubo; painful bubo
senses.collocation_zh: 腹股沟淋巴结炎性肿块；疼痛的炎性淋巴结肿块

senses.sentence_zh: 医生在患者腹股沟处发现了一处有压痛的淋巴结炎性肿块。

etymology_story.zh: bubo 经拉丁语借自希腊语 boubōn，原指“腹股沟”，也指该处的肿胀。英语保留了其医学含义，用于感染引起的淋巴结炎性肿大，尤其与腺鼠疫相关。
etymology_story.en: Bubo came through Latin from Greek boubōn, meaning 'groin' and also a swelling in that region. English retained the medical sense of an inflamed, enlarged lymph node, particularly one associated with bubonic plague.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 bubo 是不可进一步拆分的借入词，复数为 buboes。相关形容词为 bubonic：bubon-（该借词的扩展词干）+ -ic（……的）；bubonic plague 意为“腺鼠疫”，属于词组而非派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, bubo is an unsegmented loanword; its plural is buboes. The related adjective bubonic uses the extended stem bubon- plus -ic 'relating to'; bubonic plague is a phrase rather than a derived word.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: swollen lymph node（肿大的淋巴结）是较宽泛的描述性近义表达；lymphadenopathy（淋巴结病、淋巴结肿大）涵盖多种原因导致的异常；lymphadenitis（淋巴结炎）强调炎症过程。bubo 特指由感染引起的局部明显肿大，常伴疼痛。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Swollen lymph node is a broader descriptive equivalent. Lymphadenopathy covers abnormal lymph nodes from various causes, while lymphadenitis emphasizes inflammation; bubo refers to a conspicuous localized swelling caused by infection, often with pain.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 从原义“腹股沟”联想到该处肿痛的淋巴结，再连接 bubonic plague“腺鼠疫”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Connect the original meaning 'groin' with a painful swollen lymph node there, then link bubo to bubonic plague.

pronunciation.note: 采用美式读音；将词典发音符号转写为 IPA。

etymology.text: 英语借自中古法语 guidon，与 guide 的“引导”含义有关；用小旗引导、标识队伍，便容易记住这个词。

usage_note: 军事语境用词，常指标明单位的小旗；同词也可指持旗者，本课只学旗帜义。

senses.meaning_zh: 用于标识部队或引导集合的军用小旗；队旗
senses.meaning_en: A small military flag used to identify a unit or mark its position.
senses.english_definition: A guidon is a small flag carried by a military unit to identify it and show where its members should gather.
senses.collocation_en: company guidon; carry the guidon
senses.collocation_zh: 连队队旗；持队旗

etymology_story.zh: guidon 借自法语 guidon，与表示“引导”的 guide 同源。它在英语中用于军队的小旗，体现了旗帜引导、集合和标识队伍的作用。
etymology_story.en: Guidon was borrowed from French guidon and is historically related to guide. In English it came to denote a small military flag, reflecting the flag's role in directing, rallying, and identifying a unit.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 guidon 作为完整借入词处理，不宜分析为 guide 加现代英语后缀 -on；复数为 guidons。相关复合表达有 guidon bearer 或 guidon-bearer“队旗手”、guidon pole“队旗旗杆”；guide、guidance、guided、guiding 属历史相关词，不是 guidon 的直接派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, guidon is a complete loanword, not guide plus a productive English suffix -on; its plural is guidons. Related compounds include guidon bearer or guidon-bearer and guidon pole; guide, guidance, guided, and guiding are historically related words rather than direct derivatives of guidon.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: flag（旗）是最宽泛的名称；pennant（三角旗、燕尾旗）侧重旗形，并不限于军用；standard（军旗、仪仗旗）强调正式的部队或组织象征。guidon 特指用于部队识别及集合的小型队旗。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Flag is the broad general term. Pennant emphasizes a tapering or swallow-tailed shape and need not be military, while standard emphasizes a formal emblem of a unit or organization; guidon specifically denotes a small military identification and rallying flag.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把 guidon 与同源的 guide“引导”相连：一面引导士兵集合、标明队伍的小旗。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Link guidon with its historical relative guide: a small flag guides soldiers to their unit and marks its position.

etymology_story.zh: bagatelle 经法语借自意大利语 bagattella，意为“小事、小玩意儿”。英语保留了这一含义，后来又将它用于轻巧的器乐小品和一种桌上滚球游戏。
etymology_story.en: Bagatelle came through French from Italian bagattella, meaning 'a trifle' or 'a small thing'. English retained that meaning and later applied the word to a light instrumental composition and a table game played with balls.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 bagatelle 是整体借入词，没有可自由使用的英语词根与词缀拆分；复数为 bagatelles。没有常用的英语词缀派生词；bagatelle board、bagatelle table、bagatelle player 分别表示游戏板、游戏台和玩家，均为复合表达。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, bagatelle is an unsegmented loanword without a productive English root-and-affix analysis; its plural is bagatelles. It has no common English affixal derivatives; bagatelle board, bagatelle table, and bagatelle player are compound expressions.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: trifle（小事、小数目）接近其一般含义；triviality（琐事）更强调缺乏重要性，有时带贬义；miniature（小型作品）可对应其音乐义，但不一定具有轻快风格。这些词都不能直接替代其游戏名称。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Trifle closely matches the general sense of something small or unimportant. Triviality stresses lack of importance and can sound dismissive, while miniature can describe a small musical work without implying a light character; none directly replaces the game name.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 抓住原义“小玩意儿”：小事情、短小曲、轻松小游戏，三个义项围绕“小而轻巧”相连。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Anchor the word in 'a small thing': a minor matter, a short musical piece, and a light table game.

meaning: 德梅拉拉粗粒浅褐蔗糖

pronunciation.note: 采用 Collins 所列美式读音 /ˌdɛməˈrærə/。

forms: 糖的名称，通常不可数；也常说 demerara sugar。
family: demerara sugar 德梅拉拉糖；cane sugar 蔗糖。

morphology.text: demerara 作为独立名称整体记忆；demerara + sugar → demerara sugar，组成这种粗粒蔗糖的完整名称。

etymology.text: 英语由圭亚那地区名 Demerara 命名这种糖，因为那里曾是它的产地；从产地名称记到食品名称即可。

usage_note: 英式烘焙语境常见，糖名可小写 demerara；地名 Demerara 则大写。它不等同于所有种类的 brown sugar。

senses.meaning_zh: 德梅拉拉糖；带糖蜜风味的粗粒浅褐色蔗糖
senses.meaning_en: Coarse, light-brown cane sugar with a molasses flavor.
senses.english_definition: Demerara is light-brown cane sugar with large crystals, often used in coffee or baking.
senses.collocation_en: demerara sugar; a sprinkling of demerara
senses.collocation_zh: 德梅拉拉糖；撒上的少量德梅拉拉糖
senses.sentence_en: Sprinkle demerara over the cake before baking to give it a crunchy topping.
senses.sentence_zh: 烘烤前在蛋糕上撒些德梅拉拉糖，使表面形成一层酥脆的糖皮。

etymology_story.zh: 该词得名于德梅拉拉，即今圭亚那境内一个历史上生产和出口蔗糖的地区。产地名称后来成为这种粗粒浅褐色蔗糖的通称，并不表示如今所有这种糖都产自那里。
etymology_story.en: The word comes from Demerara, a region in present-day Guyana historically associated with producing and exporting cane sugar. The place name became a general name for this coarse, light-brown sugar, regardless of where it is now produced.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中作为借自地名的整体词使用，没有可用于释义的现代词根和词缀划分。通常为不可数名词；demerara sugar（德梅拉拉糖）是常见组合，其中 demerara 作名词修饰语；没有常用的派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, demerara is a whole word taken from a place name, with no useful division into productive roots and affixes. It is normally uncountable; in demerara sugar, demerara functions as a noun modifier, and it has no common family of derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: brown sugar（红糖或黄糖）是范围更广的类别名称；turbinado sugar（特比纳多糖）也是带糖蜜风味的粗粒糖，但并非完全相同的产品；muscovado（穆斯科瓦多糖）通常更湿润、颜色更深，糖蜜味也更浓。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Brown sugar is a broader category; turbinado sugar is a similar coarse sugar retaining some molasses, but is not an identical product; muscovado is generally moister, darker, and more strongly flavored with molasses.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 产地变糖名：Demerara 地区 → 带糖蜜风味的浅褐色粗粒糖。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Place becomes product: Demerara the region → coarse, light-brown sugar with a molasses flavor.

meaning: 随想曲（形式自由、常轻快华丽的器乐曲）

pronunciation.note: 采用美式读音；将词典发音符号转写为 IPA。

forms: 可数名词；英语复数 capriccios。
family: capriccioso 自由随性的（音乐指示语）；caprice 奇想。

morphology.text: capriccio 作为独立词素整体记忆；capriccio + -like（像……的）→ capriccio-like（具有随想曲特点的），用于描述乐曲自由随性的风格。

etymology.text: 英语直接借自意大利语 capriccio，把“奇想、随性”的意味带入音乐，成为形式自由的器乐曲名称。

relations.meaning: 自由随性的（音乐演奏指示）

usage_note: 音乐体裁名，通常小写。本课只学器乐曲义；a capriccio 指一首随想曲。

senses.meaning_zh: 随想曲；形式较自由、常富于变化和技巧性的乐曲
senses.meaning_en: A freely structured musical composition, often lively or technically brilliant.
senses.english_definition: A capriccio is a piece of music with a relatively free form that often includes lively changes of mood or displays of technical skill.
senses.collocation_en: a piano capriccio; a capriccio for violin
senses.collocation_zh: 钢琴随想曲；小提琴随想曲
senses.sentence_en: She ended the recital with a dazzling capriccio for solo violin.
senses.sentence_zh: 她以一首炫技的小提琴独奏随想曲结束了这场独奏会。

senses.meaning_zh: 幻想风景画；将真实或虚构建筑自由组合的绘画
senses.meaning_en: An imaginative landscape or architectural painting combining real or invented features.
senses.english_definition: A capriccio is a painting that combines buildings, ruins, or landscape features in an imaginary arrangement.
senses.collocation_en: an architectural capriccio; a capriccio of classical ruins
senses.collocation_zh: 建筑幻想画；以古典遗迹为题材的幻想画
senses.sentence_en: The capriccio places Roman ruins beside an imaginary Venetian canal.
senses.sentence_zh: 这幅幻想画把罗马遗迹置于一条虚构的威尼斯运河旁。

etymology_story.zh: 英语借自意大利语 capriccio，意为“奇想、随兴之举”，随后用于指构思自由的乐曲和凭想象组合景物的绘画。这个意大利语词更早的来源存在争议。
etymology_story.en: English borrowed Italian capriccio, meaning a whim or fancy, and applied it to freely conceived music and imaginatively arranged paintings. The deeper origin of the Italian word is disputed.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中是整体借词，不宜硬拆为英语词根和词缀；复数为 capriccios 或意大利语形式 capricci。相关词族包括 caprice（突发奇想）、capricious（反复无常的）、capriciously（反复无常地）和 capriciousness（反复无常）；这些是历史相关词，并非都由英语 capriccio 直接派生。
morphology_enriched.en: Capriccio is a whole-word borrowing rather than a productive English root-and-affix formation; its plurals are capriccios and Italian capricci. Related words include caprice, capricious, capriciously, and capriciousness; these are historically related forms, not all direct English derivatives of capriccio.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 音乐义中，fantasia（幻想曲）同样强调构思自由，scherzo（谐谑曲）更强调活泼诙谐且常有较明确的曲式；绘画义中，veduta（城市景观画）通常着重呈现可辨认的真实景观，而 capriccio 允许自由虚构和拼合。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: In music, fantasia similarly emphasizes imaginative freedom, while scherzo emphasizes playful energy and often follows a more recognizable form. In painting, a veduta generally depicts an identifiable actual view, whereas a capriccio freely invents or combines its setting.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 抓住“奇想”：用音符写奇想是随想曲，用建筑拼奇想是幻想画。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Anchor it to fancy: a fancy expressed in notes becomes a musical capriccio; one assembled from buildings becomes a painted capriccio.

meaning: 曼德拉草（根常分叉的地中海植物）

pronunciation.note: 采用美式读音；将词典发音符号转写为 IPA。

forms: 植物作个体时可数；复数 mandrakes。
family: mandrake-like 像曼德拉草的；Mandragora 曼德拉草属名。

morphology.text: mandrake 作为独立词素整体记忆；mandrake + -like → mandrake-like，表示“像曼德拉草的”。-like 构成表示相似的形容词，不把原词硬拆成 man 与 drake。

etymology.text: mandrake 在中古英语时期已出现，与更早的 mandragora 名称相连；后者经拉丁语追溯至希腊语。可用那种常分叉、形似人形的根帮助记忆植物。

usage_note: 植物名称，通常小写。本课指真实的地中海植物，文学中的神奇描写不属于植物定义。

senses.meaning_zh: 曼德拉草；根粗大且常分叉的地中海地区茄科植物，也指其根
senses.meaning_en: A Mediterranean nightshade plant with a thick, often forked root, or the root itself.
senses.english_definition: A mandrake is a Mediterranean plant whose thick root sometimes resembles a human figure and has long been associated with magic.
senses.collocation_en: mandrake root; a mandrake plant
senses.collocation_zh: 曼德拉草根；一株曼德拉草

senses.sentence_zh: 插图画着一株曼德拉草，其分叉的根形似人形。

senses.meaning_zh: 美洲鬼臼；盾叶鬼臼，亦称 American mandrake
senses.meaning_en: The mayapple, a North American woodland plant also called American mandrake.
senses.english_definition: In North American usage, mandrake can also mean the mayapple, a woodland plant with broad, umbrella-shaped leaves.
senses.collocation_en: American mandrake; mandrake leaves
senses.collocation_zh: 美洲鬼臼；美洲鬼臼的叶片

senses.sentence_zh: 美洲鬼臼生长在树下，宽大的叶片像伞一样展开。

etymology_story.zh: mandrake 经中古英语中的相关形式，追溯到拉丁语 mandragora 和希腊语 mandragoras，是一个古老的植物名称。后来，北美的盾叶鬼臼因根部用途等相似之处，也获得了 American mandrake 这一俗名。
etymology_story.en: Mandrake developed through Middle English forms related to Latin mandragora and Greek mandragoras, an ancient plant name. The North American mayapple later acquired the common name American mandrake through perceived similarities, including uses of its underground parts.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 mandrake 是不可按意义拆分的整体词，并非 man（男人）+ drake（公鸭）；复数为 mandrakes。常见组合包括 mandrake root（曼德拉草根）和 American mandrake（美洲鬼臼）；mandragora（曼德拉草属或其名称）是历史相关形式，没有常用的现代派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, mandrake is an unanalyzable base, not man + drake; its plural is mandrakes. Common combinations include mandrake root and American mandrake; mandragora is a historically related botanical form, and there is no common modern family of derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: mandragora（曼德拉草或曼德拉草属）与地中海植物义相关，偏植物学用语；mayapple（盾叶鬼臼）对应北美植物义；American mandrake（美洲鬼臼）明确指后者，不能据此把两种植物视为同一种。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Mandragora is a botanical term associated with the Mediterranean plant or its genus; mayapple names the North American plant; American mandrake explicitly identifies that second plant, which is distinct from Mediterranean mandrake.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 人形分叉根 → 曼德拉草；加上 American，联想到伞形大叶的美洲鬼臼。
mnemonic_anchor.en: A human-shaped, forked root anchors Mediterranean mandrake; American mandrake points instead to the mayapple with umbrella-like leaves.

meaning: 选举学；对选举的科学研究

pronunciation.note: 采用美式读音；将词典发音符号转写为 IPA。

forms: 学科名，通常不可数。
family: psephologist 选举研究者；psephological 选举研究的。

morphology.text: psepho-（投票石）+ -logy（研究）→ psephology，选举学；相应研究者称 psephologist。

etymology.text: 这是用希腊语词素组成的现代英语学科名；psēphos 表示“小石子”，古希腊人曾用石子投票，因此石子成为选举研究的命名线索。

usage_note: 正式学术词汇；开头 ps 的 p 不发音。它研究选举与投票行为，不是选举投票这个动作本身。

senses.meaning_zh: 选举学；尤指运用统计方法研究选举与投票行为的学科
senses.meaning_en: The scientific study of elections and voting behavior, especially through statistics.
senses.english_definition: Psephology is the study of elections and how people vote, particularly by analyzing voting figures and patterns.
senses.collocation_en: the study of psephology; an expert in psephology
senses.collocation_zh: 对选举学的研究；选举学专家
senses.sentence_en: Her interest in psephology began when she compared voting patterns across different regions.
senses.sentence_zh: 她在比较不同地区的投票模式时，开始对选举学产生兴趣。

etymology_story.zh: 这是现代英语用希腊语 psēphos（小石子）与表示“研究”的 -logy 构成的学科名称。古希腊人曾用小石子投票，因此“小石子”成为研究选举的命名依据。
etymology_story.en: This modern English term combines Greek psēphos, meaning a pebble, with -logy, meaning study. Because pebbles were used in voting in ancient Greece, the pebble supplied the naming connection to elections.

morphology_enriched.zh: psepho-（小石子；引申为投票）+ -logy（研究、学科）→ psephology（选举学）。主要词族为 psephologist（选举学家）和 psephological（选举学的）；词首 p 不发音。
morphology_enriched.en: Psepho- (pebble, extended to voting) + -logy (study) forms psephology. Its principal derivatives are psephologist, a specialist in the field, and psephological, relating to the field; the initial p is silent.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: electoral studies（选举研究）范围较广，可涵盖选举制度和法律；electoral analysis（选举分析）强调对具体选举或数据进行分析；voting-behavior research（投票行为研究）侧重选民如何以及为何作出选择。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Electoral studies is broader and can include electoral institutions and law; electoral analysis emphasizes examining particular elections or datasets; voting-behavior research focuses on how and why voters make their choices.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 一颗石子代表一票：psepho- 投票石 + -logy 研究 → 选举学。
mnemonic_anchor.en: One pebble, one vote: psepho- voting pebble + -logy study → the study of elections.

etymology_story.zh: 英语借用了西班牙语和葡萄牙语的 selva（森林），该词源于拉丁语 silva（树林、森林）。进入英语地理用语后，其含义主要集中于热带雨林，尤其是亚马孙地区的雨林。
etymology_story.en: English borrowed selva from Spanish and Portuguese, where it means forest and derives from Latin silva, meaning woodland or forest. In English geographical usage, it became associated chiefly with tropical rainforest, especially in the Amazon region.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 selva 是整体借词，没有可用于释义的现代英语词根和词缀划分；复数为 selvas。没有常用的英语派生词族；sylvan（森林的）和 silviculture（造林学）与它共享拉丁语来源，但不是从 selva 派生出来的。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, selva is a whole-word borrowing with no useful division into productive English roots and affixes; its plural is selvas. It has no common English derivative family; sylvan and silviculture share its Latin ancestry but are not derived from selva.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: tropical rainforest（热带雨林）是最接近且更通用的表达；jungle（丛林）强调植被茂密难行，不一定严格指雨林；forest（森林）范围最广，不限定热带气候或高降雨量。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Tropical rainforest is the closest and more widely used equivalent; jungle emphasizes dense, tangled vegetation and does not always mean rainforest precisely; forest is the broadest term and specifies neither a tropical climate nor high rainfall.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 拉丁语 silva 表示森林；记住 selva 是英语地理词汇中偏指南美洲的热带密林。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Latin silva means forest; anchor selva to the dense tropical forests of South America.

etymology_story.zh: soke 经中古英语及中世纪拉丁语 soca，追溯至古英语 sōcn，原有“寻求、追诉”的含义。它由寻求司法救济或接受法庭管辖，发展为地方司法管辖权及其所辖地区的名称。参见[《美国传统英语词典》](https://ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=soke)。
etymology_story.en: Soke came through Middle English and Medieval Latin soca from Old English sōcn, meaning an act of seeking or legal pursuit. Its legal meanings developed around recourse or submission to a court, encompassing both local jurisdiction and the territory subject to it. See the [American Heritage Dictionary](https://ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=soke).

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中是不可再作生产性拆分的单纯词：soke；复数 sokes。历史相关词包括 sokeman／socman（索克佃农；具体身份依时期和地区而异），复数 sokemen／socmen，以及 sokemanry（索克佃农群体或其身份）；soken 是相关历史形式。它与 seek 有历史联系，但不是现代英语中 seek 加后缀构成的词。
morphology_enriched.en: Synchronically, soke is a simple base without productive internal segmentation; its plural is sokes. Historical relatives include sokeman/socman, a tenant whose precise status varied by period and locality; the plurals sokemen/socmen; sokemanry, the tenants collectively or their status; and the related historical form soken. Its relationship to seek is historical rather than a modern affixation pattern.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: jurisdiction（司法管辖权）是范围更广的现代术语；judicial franchise（特许司法权）强调获授或享有的司法特权；district（地区、辖区）只对应地域义，本身不包含特定的封建司法制度。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Jurisdiction is the broader modern term for judicial authority; judicial franchise emphasizes a granted or privileged judicial right; district matches the territorial sense but does not itself imply the historical legal institution.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: “寻求裁判”→“归某法庭管”→“管辖权及辖区”；这是语义记忆链。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Seeking judgment → coming under a court → its authority and territory: remember the legal meaning through this semantic chain.

etymology_story.zh: 材料名 frit 来自意大利语 fritta，意为“煎过的”，与 friggere（煎）及拉丁语 frīgere 有关，名称突出加热处理。形容词 frit 则是与 fright／frightened 有关的英国方言形式，与材料义不同源。参见[《柯林斯英语词典》](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/frit)和[《剑桥词典》](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/frit)。
etymology_story.en: The material name frit comes from Italian fritta, meaning fried, related to friggere and Latin frīgere, and refers to processing by heat. The adjective is a separate British dialect form associated with fright/frightened, rather than with the material name. See [Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/frit) and [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/frit).

morphology_enriched.zh: 材料义的名词 frit 可零派生为动词 frit；名词复数及动词第三人称单数均为 frits。动词采用 frit + -ed → fritted、frit + -ing → fritting，均双写 t；fritted 也可作分词形容词，如 fritted glass（熔结玻璃）。常见复合表达有 glass frit（玻璃熔块）、frit powder（熔块粉）和 frit-based glaze（以熔块为基础的釉料）；形容词 frit（害怕的）属于另一个词源分支。
morphology_enriched.en: The material noun frit also functions as a verb by zero derivation; frits is both the noun plural and the third-person singular verb form. The verb doubles t in frit + -ed → fritted and frit + -ing → fritting; fritted also functions as a participial adjective, as in fritted glass. Common combinations include glass frit, frit powder, and frit-based glaze. The adjective meaning frightened belongs to a separate etymological branch.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 材料及加工义中，glass powder（玻璃粉）强调颗粒形态，不一定专为釉料等用途预制；sinter（烧结）强调颗粒经加热结合，工艺上不等于所有熔块制造过程。形容词义中，frightened（害怕的）是通用对应词，frit 带有英国地域及非正式色彩。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: For the material and process senses, glass powder describes particle form without necessarily implying preparation for glazes or similar uses; sinter emphasizes bonding particles by heat and is not interchangeable with every frit-making process. For the adjective, frightened is the general equivalent, while frit carries British regional and informal associations.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 材料义记“先受热熔合，再用于制品”；害怕义联想 frightened，分开记忆。
mnemonic_anchor.en: For the material, think heat first, manufacture later; for the adjective, connect frit with frightened and keep the two origins separate.

etymology_story.zh: groyne 的起源并不完全确定，可能与旧词 groin（兽嘴，尤指猪嘴）有关，后者来自古法语 groin／groign。由突出的兽嘴联想到伸入水中的构筑物，是一种可能的语义发展，不能当作已经确证的词源。参见[《柯林斯英语词典》](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/groyne)和[《在线词源词典》](https://www.etymonline.com/word/groyne)。

A comparison between a projecting snout and a structure extending into water is a possible semantic development rather than an established certainty. See [Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/groyne) and the [Online Etymology Dictionary](https://www.etymonline.com/word/groyne).

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中作为单纯词整体识记：groyne；复数 groynes。美式英语常拼作 groin，复数 groins；groyning 是专业语境中的相关形式，可指丁坝修筑或丁坝工程，拼写时去掉词尾 e 再加 -ing。常见组合有 groyne field（丁坝群）和 groyne construction（丁坝修筑）；没有常用的形容词或副词派生形式。
morphology_enriched.en: Treat groyne as a simple modern base; its plural is groynes. The usual American spelling is groin, plural groins. The specialist related form groyning can refer to constructing groynes or to groyne works and drops final e before -ing. Common combinations include groyne field and groyne construction; there are no common derived adjective or adverb forms.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: spur（挑流坝、丁坝）强调从岸边伸出以改变水流的构筑物；breakwater（防波堤）主要用于削弱波浪；seawall（海堤、海岸防护墙）通常沿岸修建，而 groyne 通常从岸边向水中伸出。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Spur emphasizes a projecting structure that redirects flow; breakwater primarily denotes protection against waves; seawall usually runs along the shore, whereas a groyne projects outward from it.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把海岸想成伸出一只短嘴，拦住沿岸移动的沙；这是形象记忆，词源关联仍有不确定性。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture the shore sticking out a short snout to catch passing sand; use this as a visual hook while remembering that the etymological connection is uncertain.

etymology_story.zh: 挽具义 hame 经中古英语借自中古荷兰语 hame（马颈圈或挽具）。表示“家”的 hame 则是 home 的苏格兰语对应形式，追溯至古英语 hām，属于另一词源。参见[《柯林斯英语词典》](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/hame)和[《苏格兰语词典》](https://dsl.ac.uk/entry/snd/hame)。
etymology_story.en: The harness term hame entered Middle English from Middle Dutch hame, referring to a horse collar or harness. Hame meaning home is a separate Scots counterpart of home, ultimately from Old English hām. See [Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/hame) and the [Dictionaries of the Scots Language](https://dsl.ac.uk/entry/snd/hame).

morphology_enriched.zh: 两个词源分支在现代均可作为单纯词识记。挽具义常用复数 hames，复合词有 hame strap／hamestrap（夹板连接带）和 hame fastener（夹板紧固件）；表示“家”的苏格兰语分支有 hame + -ward → hameward（向家的）以及 hame-comin／hamecoming（归家、返乡）。较全面的苏格兰语词典还记录形容词和动词用法，但不应把 home 的全部词性不加区别地视为 hame 的常用英语词性。
morphology_enriched.en: Both etymological branches function as simple modern bases. The harness noun commonly occurs as plural hames, with compounds such as hame strap/hamestrap and hame fastener. The Scots home branch has hame + -ward → hameward and hame-comin/hamecoming. Fuller Scots dictionaries also record adjectival and verbal uses, but the full POS inventory of home should not automatically be presented as common English usage of hame.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 挽具义没有严格的日常单词近义词：collar（颈圈）是承受挽拉压力的衬垫部件，hame 是装在其上的硬质支架；harness（挽具）指整套装备。表示“家”时，home 是标准英语对应词，hame 保留苏格兰地域色彩。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: There is no exact everyday synonym for the harness component: collar denotes the padded part that bears the pulling pressure, while a hame is a rigid support fitted to it; harness denotes the equipment as a whole. In the other branch, home is the standard English equivalent, while hame retains its Scots association.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 挽具义记“颈圈两侧的硬夹板”；苏格兰语义把 hame 对应到 home，两个来源分开记。
mnemonic_anchor.en: For the harness sense, picture the rigid supports beside the collar; for Scots usage, pair hame with home and keep the origins separate.

etymology_story.zh: 餐饮用语 appy 由 appetizer 截短后加口语后缀 -y／-ie 形成；医疗用法则是 appendix、appendicitis 或 appendectomy 的类似缩略形式，具体所指依语境而定。实际用例可见[餐厅菜单](https://www.twoguyspizza.ca/admin/resources/two-guys-dine-in-menu-february-23-changes-proof-1.pdf)及[医院手术项目](https://www.fitzgibbon.org/medical-services/our-services/surgical-services/surgery-unit)。
etymology_story.en: The food term appy is formed by shortening appetizer and adding informal -y/-ie; medical uses similarly shorten appendix, appendicitis, or appendectomy, with the referent determined by context. Examples occur in a [restaurant menu](https://www.twoguyspizza.ca/admin/resources/two-guys-dine-in-menu-february-23-changes-proof-1.pdf) and a [hospital's surgical listings](https://www.fitzgibbon.org/medical-services/our-services/surgical-services/surgery-unit).

morphology_enriched.zh: 餐饮义的现代构词可表示为 appetizer → app- + -y／-ie → appy／appie；常见复数 appies，也可见 appys。医疗义可同样分析为相关长词的截短加口语词尾；这些是不同全词的缩略，不能把 app- 当作统一的实义词根。appetizer、appetize、appetizing、appetizingly 属于餐饮分支的相关词；appendix、appendicitis、appendectomy 属于医疗分支。表示 happy 的 appy／'appy 是记录省略 /h/ 发音的非标准拼写，不宜当作独立的常用形容词词条。
morphology_enriched.en: For the food sense, the modern formation is appetizer → app- + -y/-ie → appy/appie; appies is a common plural, and appys also occurs. Medical forms similarly combine shortening with an informal ending; these shorten different full words, so app- is not a single shared meaning-bearing root. Appetizer, appetize, appetizing, and appetizingly belong to the food-related family; appendix, appendicitis, and appendectomy belong to the medical branch. Appy/'appy representing happy is a nonstandard spelling of an /h/-dropping pronunciation rather than a separate common adjective lexeme.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: appetizer（开胃菜）是餐饮义的完整形式；starter（前菜）在英国英语中特别常见，更明确指一道餐前菜；appendectomy（阑尾切除术）只对应医疗手术义，比语境依赖较强的 appy 明确。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Appetizer is the full form of the food sense; starter is particularly common in British English and more specifically suggests a first course; appendectomy matches only the surgical sense and is more explicit than the context-dependent slang term appy.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 看场景还原长词：餐桌上的 appy → appetizer；医院里的 appy → appendix／appendicitis／appendectomy。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Restore the long word from the setting: at the table, appy points to appetizer; in hospital, it points to appendix, appendicitis, or appendectomy.

etymology_story.zh: 表示女保姆的 ayah 经印地语、乌尔都语 āyā 借入，源自葡萄牙语 aia（女家庭教师、保姆）；它与拉丁语 avia（祖母）的进一步联系尚有不确定性。表示经文的 ayah 是来源独立的同形词，来自阿拉伯语 āyah，意为“迹象、征兆；经文的一节”。
etymology_story.en: The nursemaid word entered English through Hindi and Urdu āyā, from Portuguese aia, meaning a governess or nursemaid; its further connection with Latin avia, 'grandmother,' is uncertain. The Quranic word has a separate origin in Arabic āyah, meaning a sign or an individual verse.

morphology_enriched.zh: 两个义项在现代英语中都把 ayah 作为不可再分析的借词词干，没有可拆分的英语前后缀。保姆义：ayah + -s → ayahs；经文义：复数可用 ayahs，也可保留阿拉伯语复数 ayat；没有通行的英语派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: Both words function as unanalyzable borrowed stems in modern English, with no English prefix or suffix to separate. For the nursemaid sense, ayah + -s produces ayahs; for the Quranic sense, the plural is ayahs or the borrowed Arabic plural ayat. Neither has an established English derivational family.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: nanny（保姆）是现代通用的儿童照护职业名称；nursemaid（育儿女仆）更有旧时家庭雇佣色彩，二者都没有 ayah 特有的南亚背景。经文义近于 verse（经文的一节），但 ayah 专指《古兰经》的经节。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Nanny is the ordinary modern term for a person employed to care for children; nursemaid more strongly suggests an older household role, while ayah adds a specifically South Asian context. In its Quranic sense, ayah corresponds to verse but refers specifically to a verse of the Quran.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 用两个独立场景记同形词：南亚家中照看孩子的阿娅；《古兰经》中逐节诵读的阿亚。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Use two separate scenes: an ayah caring for children in South Asia, and an ayah being recited from the Quran.

etymology_story.zh: crake 可追溯到中古英语 crake，并与古诺尔斯语 kráka（乌鸦）有关，其更早的基础通常被认为是模仿鸟叫声。这个与粗厉叫声相关的名称后来用于某些秧鸡科鸟类。
etymology_story.en: Crake goes back to Middle English crake and is connected with Old Norse kráka, 'crow,' with an ultimately imitative origin generally proposed. A name associated with harsh bird calls came to be used for certain birds of the rail family.

morphology_enriched.zh: crake 是现代英语中的单纯词，不能拆成有意义的英语词根和词缀。crake + -s → crakes（复数）；corn + crake → corncrake（长脚秧鸡）；spotted crake（斑胸田鸡）和 little crake（姬田鸡）是多词鸟名，不是词缀派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: Crake is a simple word in modern English, without a meaningful English root-and-affix division. Crake + -s gives the plural crakes; corn + crake forms corncrake. Spotted crake and little crake are multiword bird names rather than affix-derived words.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: rail（秧鸡科鸟类）范围更广，crake 通常用于其中较小、短喙的成员；corncrake（长脚秧鸡）指一种具体的鸟；water rail（普通秧鸡）也是具体鸟种，喙较长，不能与 crake 随意互换。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Rail is the broader term for birds in this family, whereas crake is typically used for smaller, short-billed members. Corncrake names a particular species; water rail names another, longer-billed species and is not an interchangeable equivalent of crake.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 从粗厉的鸟叫联想到名字：草丛里传来一声“crake”，短喙秧鸡随即藏起。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Connect the sound-based name with a scene: a harsh 'crake' comes from the grass, and a short-billed rail disappears.

senses.meaning_zh: 长匕首，尤指传统苏格兰高地长匕首；dirk 的复数
senses.meaning_en: Long daggers, especially traditional Scottish Highland daggers; the plural of dirk.

etymology_story.zh: 单数 dirk 在16世纪苏格兰语中已有 dork、durk 等形式，最初指一种匕首，其更早来源尚不确定。它后来尤其与苏格兰高地传统长匕首相联系，dirks 则是英语规则复数形式。
etymology_story.en: The singular dirk appears in sixteenth-century Scots in forms such as dork and durk, referring to a dagger; its earlier origin is uncertain. It became particularly associated with the traditional Highland dagger, and dirks is its regular English plural.

morphology_enriched.zh: dirk + -s → dirks；-s 是复数屈折词尾，因为前接清辅音 /k/，读作 /s/。dirk 是不可再拆的词干；另有历史性动词 dirk（用匕首刺），其形式包括 dirks、dirked、dirking，但该动词不属于现代常用词性。
morphology_enriched.en: Dirk + -s produces dirks; -s is a plural inflection pronounced /s/ after the voiceless consonant /k/. Dirk is an unanalyzable stem. A historical verb dirk, meaning to stab with a dagger, also has the forms dirks, dirked, and dirking, but it is not a common modern use.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: daggers（匕首）是最接近的上位词；knives（刀）范围更广，也包括日常工具；stilettos（细刃匕首）强调细长尖锐的刀刃，而 dirks 尤其带有苏格兰高地传统背景。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Daggers is the closest broader term; knives also includes ordinary cutting tools. Stilettos emphasizes slender, sharply pointed blades, whereas dirks particularly evokes the Scottish Highland tradition.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 先记 dirk 是高地长匕首，再加复数 -s：腰间陈列的几把长匕首就是 dirks。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture a Highland dagger as a dirk, then add plural -s: several of those daggers are dirks.

senses.pos: v. 动词（不及物；英式非正式）
senses.meaning_zh: 瞎忙；磨蹭；花时间做无关紧要的事
senses.meaning_en: To waste time on unimportant or ineffective activity.
senses.english_definition: If someone faffs around or faffs about, they spend time doing unnecessary things instead of making useful progress.
senses.collocation_en: faff about; faff around
senses.collocation_zh: 瞎忙；磨蹭

senses.meaning_zh: 麻烦费事的过程；不必要的折腾
senses.meaning_en: An unnecessarily troublesome or time-consuming task or process.
senses.english_definition: If you describe something as a faff, you mean that doing it involves more trouble or effort than you think it should.
senses.collocation_en: a bit of a faff; such a faff
senses.collocation_zh: 有点费事；这么麻烦的一番折腾
senses.sentence_en: Booking tickets through the website was a bit of a faff.
senses.sentence_zh: 通过这个网站订票有点费事。

etymology_story.zh: faff 见于18世纪末的英语方言，早期有“一阵阵地吹、扑动”等意思，通常被认为源于拟声。它后来发展出“忙乱而没有实质进展”的动词义，并形成表示麻烦折腾的名词用法。
etymology_story.en: Faff is recorded in late-eighteenth-century English dialect with senses such as blowing in gusts or fluttering, and is generally considered imitative. It later developed the meaning of fussing without useful progress, along with a noun use for a troublesome performance or task.

morphology_enriched.zh: faff 是单纯词；动词和名词同形，没有可独立分析的前后缀。屈折变化：faffs、faffed、faffing；faff + -er → faffer（爱磨蹭的人，非正式且较少见）；faff about、faff around 是常见短语动词。
morphology_enriched.en: Faff is a simple word, with identical noun and verb forms and no separable prefix or suffix. Its inflections are faffs, faffed, and faffing; faff + -er gives faffer, an informal and less common word for someone who wastes time this way. Faff about and faff around are common phrasal verbs.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: fuss（忙乱、过分操心）强调为细节投入过多注意；dither（犹豫磨蹭）强调拿不定主意；hassle（麻烦）主要对应名词义，强调令人烦恼的困难，而 faff 常含步骤琐碎、浪费时间的意味。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Fuss emphasizes excessive attention to details; dither emphasizes hesitation and indecision. Hassle mainly matches the noun sense and stresses annoying difficulty, while faff often suggests fiddly steps and wasted time.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 像一阵阵风扑腾：动得很多，进展很少；动词是“瞎忙”，名词是“一番折腾”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture gusts fluttering things about: plenty of movement, little progress. The verb is the pointless activity; the noun is the troublesome process.

etymology_story.en: Kelim is a variant spelling of kilim, a rug name borrowed into English through Turkish kilim from Persian gilīm, meaning a carpet or rug. In English, it retained its association with traditional flatwoven rugs without a pile.

morphology_enriched.zh: kelim 是不可再拆的借词词干，没有英语词缀结构。kelim + -s → kelims；对应拼写为 kilim、kilims；kelim rug（基里姆地毯）和 kelim weaving（基里姆织造）中的 kelim 是名词作定语，不构成独立的常用形容词义。
morphology_enriched.en: Kelim is an unanalyzable borrowed stem with no English affix structure. Kelim + -s gives kelims; the alternative spellings are kilim and kilims. In kelim rug and kelim weaving, kelim is a noun modifier rather than a separate, commonly used adjective.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: kilim 与 kelim 是同一词的不同拼写，意义相同；flatweave rug（平织地毯）是范围更广的织造类别；rug（小地毯、铺毯）最宽泛，既可有绒头，也可无绒头。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Kilim is an alternative spelling with the same meaning. Flatweave rug is a broader construction category, while rug is more general and includes both piled and pileless coverings.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把整个借词与质感绑定：平平织出来、没有绒头的图案地毯，就是 kelim。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Attach the whole borrowed word to its texture: a patterned rug woven flat, without a fluffy pile, is a kelim.

morphology_enriched.en: Modern formation: lug, an older name for the animal, + worm → lugworm. The plural is lugworms; there are no common direct derivatives, and expressions such as lugworm cast are noun combinations.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: sandworm（沙虫）范围更广，可指多种生活在沙中的蠕虫；bait worm（饵虫）按用途命名，也包括其他虫类。lugworm 则特指沙蠋这一类穴居海生环节动物。

etymology_story.zh: mesne 经盎格鲁法语进入中古英语，与古法语表示“中间的”的词形有关，最终可追溯至拉丁语 medianus。它保留在法律术语中，用来表示权利关系、层级或程序中的中间位置。
etymology_story.en: Mesne entered Middle English through Anglo-French and is related to Old French forms meaning 'middle,' ultimately from Latin medianus. It survives in legal terminology for intermediate positions in relationships, hierarchies, or proceedings.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 mesne 是不可再作常用词根与词缀拆分的形容词，没有常用派生词。mesne lord、mesne profits 和 mesne process（中间程序或中间令状）都是法律词组，不是派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, mesne is an adjective without a productive root-and-affix breakdown or common derivatives. Mesne lord, mesne profits, and mesne process are legal phrases rather than derived words.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: intermediate 强调处在两个端点或层级之间；intervening 强调出现在两者之间的时间、阶段或事物。mesne 的意义相近，但主要限于固定法律表达。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Intermediate emphasizes a position between endpoints or levels; intervening emphasizes something occurring between other things or stages. Mesne has a related meaning but is largely restricted to established legal expressions.

mnemonic_anchor.en: Mesne sounds like mean: use the idea of a middle value to remember an intermediate legal position.

senses.meaning_zh: 逻辑或科学研究的方法体系；思想工具

etymology_story.zh: organon 来自古希腊语 organon，原义为“工具、器具”，与表示“工作”的 ergon 有关。它后来用于指思想与研究的工具体系；亚里士多德的逻辑著作集也以《工具论》之名流传。
etymology_story.en: Organon comes from Greek organon, meaning 'tool' or 'instrument,' and is related to ergon, 'work.' It came to denote an instrument or system for inquiry, and Aristotle's collected logical works became known as the Organon.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语把 organon 作为完整的希腊语借词使用，不宜拆成 organ + 英语后缀 -on。复数为 organa 或 organons；没有常用的直接派生词，organ 和 organic 属于历史上相关的词，而非由现代英语 organon 直接派生。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern English treats organon as a whole Greek loanword, not as organ plus an English suffix -on. Its plurals are organa and organons; it has no common direct derivatives, while organ and organic are historically related words rather than modern derivatives of organon.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: method 指具体的做事或研究方法；methodology 指某领域的方法体系及其理论基础；framework 指组织思想的结构。organon 更强调一套作为推理或求知工具的原则和方法，带有哲学色彩。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Method names a particular procedure; methodology concerns a field's methods and their theoretical basis; framework names an organizing structure. Organon emphasizes principles and methods functioning as an instrument of reasoning or knowledge, usually in a philosophical context.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 原义是“工具”：手用工具做事，思想用 organon 求知。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Start with 'tool': hands use tools to work; thought uses an organon to investigate.

etymology_story.zh: rete 直接借自拉丁语 rete，意为“网”。英语早期用它称星盘上的网状镂空部件，解剖学也用同一形象命名血管等结构交织而成的网络。
etymology_story.en: Rete was borrowed directly from Latin rete, meaning 'net.' Early English used it for the netlike openwork part of an astrolabe, while anatomy applied the same image to networks of vessels and other structures.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：rete 是完整借词，拉丁式复数为 retia。技术性派生形容词 retial 表示“网的、网状结构的”；相关词 reticulum（小网、网状结构）、reticular（网状的）和 reticulate（呈网状的）来自同一拉丁语词族，不应全部当作英语 rete 的直接派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern formation: rete is a whole loanword with the Latin plural retia. Its technical adjective retial means 'relating to a rete'; related words reticulum, reticular, and reticulate belong to the same Latin word family and should not all be treated as direct English derivatives of rete.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: network 是最宽泛的“网络”；plexus 通常指神经或血管交织形成的丛；reticulum 常指细小的网状结构。rete 是特定解剖名称及星盘术语中使用的“网”。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Network is the broadest term; plexus usually denotes an interlacing arrangement of nerves or vessels; reticulum often names a fine netlike structure. Rete is used in particular anatomical names and as a specific astrolabe term.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 抓住拉丁语原义“网”：体内管线织成网，星盘部件也镂成网。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Keep the original meaning 'net': vessels form a bodily net, and the astrolabe carries an openwork net.

etymology_story.zh: ruddle 源于与古英语 rudu（红色、红润）有关的形式，通常被解释为带指小成分的构词。它后来专指红赭石颜料，并由名词转用为动词，表示用这种颜料涂抹或做标记。
etymology_story.en: Ruddle developed from forms related to Old English rudu, meaning 'redness,' and is generally explained as a diminutive formation. It came to name red ochre pigment and then became a verb meaning to colour or mark with that pigment.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 ruddle 通常作为完整词干记忆，名词可通过零派生转为动词。常用屈折形式为 ruddles、ruddled、ruddling：加 -ed 时在词尾 e 后加 d，加 -ing 时去掉词尾 e；ruddled 也可作分词形容词，表示“涂有红赭石的”。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern English generally treats ruddle as a whole stem, with the noun converted into a verb without an added suffix. Its regular inflected forms are ruddles, ruddled, and ruddling: add d after the final e for the past form and drop the e before -ing; ruddled can also function as a participial adjective meaning 'marked with red ochre.'

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: red ochre 是材料名称，适用范围较广；reddle 是 ruddle 的另一词形；raddle 在牧羊语境中也指用于标记的颜料，但不一定专指红赭石。作动词时，ruddle 比 mark 更明确地说明使用了红赭石。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Red ochre is the broader material name; reddle is an alternative form of ruddle; raddle can also mean sheep-marking pigment but need not specifically denote red ochre. As a verb, ruddle specifies the use of red ochre more precisely than mark does.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 从“红”连到“红标记”：一抹红赭石，羊身一个记号。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Connect redness with a red mark: a smear of ochre leaves an identifying mark on a sheep.

senses.meaning_en: to throw stones at someone or something, in Scots
senses.english_definition: If someone stanes a person or an animal, they throw stones at them.

etymology_story.zh: stane 是与标准英语 stone 对应的苏格兰语及北部方言形式，承自古英语 stān“石头”。其拼写保留了与早期形式的明显联系；动词表示用石头击打。
etymology_story.en: Stane is the Scots and northern dialect counterpart of standard English stone, inherited from Old English stān. Its spelling retains a clear connection with the earlier form; the verb means to strike or pelt with stones.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词中视为不可再分的词根 stane；名词复数为 stanes。动词形式为 stanes、staned、staning；相关苏格兰语形容词 stany 表示“多石的”，可分析为 stane + -y，去掉词尾 e。标准英语 stone、stony 是对应形式，不是由现代 stane 直接派生。
morphology_enriched.en: Synchronically, stane is an indivisible base; its noun plural is stanes. Verb forms are stanes, staned, and staning; the related Scots adjective stany, meaning 'stony,' can be analysed as stane + -y, with final e dropped. Standard English stone and stony are corresponding forms rather than direct derivatives of modern stane.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: stone（石头；用石头打）是标准英语中最直接的对应词；rock（岩石；石块）作名词时更突出岩石材料或较大的石块；pelt（连续投掷东西击打）作动词不限定投掷物必须是石头。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Stone is the direct standard English equivalent as both noun and verb; rock, as a noun, emphasizes rocky material or a substantial piece of it; pelt means to bombard with thrown objects, which need not be stones.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把 stane 与 stone 对照记：名词是“石头”，动词是“拿石头打”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Pair stane with stone: the noun names the object, and the verb means using it to pelt something.

etymology.text: 由商标 Tipp-Ex 转为普通动词；品牌名结合德语 tippen（打字）与拉丁语 ex（向外），像把打错的字移出去。

etymology_story.zh: 来自德国修正用品商标 Tipp-Ex，品牌名结合了与德语 tippen“打字”有关的 Tipp 和拉丁语 ex“向外”。英语随后把这个品牌名称转用为动词，表示用涂改液盖住文字。
etymology_story.en: The word comes from the German correction-products trademark Tipp-Ex, combining Tipp, associated with German tippen 'to type,' and Latin ex 'out.' English subsequently adopted the brand name as a verb meaning to cover writing with correction fluid.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 tippex 是作为整体借入的品牌名称，并通过名词转动词形成“涂改”的用法；不是由英语中能自由组合的 tipp 和 ex 构成。动词形式为 tippexes、tippexed、tippexing；名词通常不可数，商标通常写作 Tipp-Ex。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, tippex is a borrowed brand-name base, with the verb formed by conversion from the name; it is not a productive combination of English tipp and ex. Verb forms are tippexes, tippexed, and tippexing; the noun is normally uncountable, and the trademark is usually written Tipp-Ex.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: correction fluid（涂改液）是中性的通用产品名称；whiteout（涂改液；用涂改液涂掉）主要用于美国英语；erase（擦除）通常表示去掉原有痕迹，而 tippex 表示用不透明的修正材料覆盖痕迹。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Correction fluid is the neutral generic product name; whiteout is chiefly American English and can name the fluid or the action; erase usually means removing a mark, whereas tippex means covering it with opaque correction material.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 打字出错，用 Tipp-Ex 让错字“出局”；这是品牌名称的记忆联想。
mnemonic_anchor.en: A typing error goes 'out' under Tipp-Ex: connect the brand name with covering a typo.

etymology.text: 经中古拉丁语 alembicum 来自阿拉伯语 al-anbīq（蒸馏器），再追溯到希腊语 ambix（杯）；可以想象杯状容器收集冷凝液。

usage_note: 多见于炼金术史、旧式化学或传统蒸馏工艺。本卡教实体器具，非比喻性的“提炼过程”。

senses.meaning_zh: 蒸馏器；尤指带有收集、引导冷凝液装置的旧式蒸馏器
senses.meaning_en: an old-style apparatus for distillation
senses.english_definition: An alembic is a device that separates substances by heating a liquid and then cooling its vapour back into liquid.
senses.collocation_en: a copper alembic; distil in an alembic
senses.collocation_zh: 铜制蒸馏器；在蒸馏器中蒸馏
senses.sentence_en: The distiller heated the liquid in a copper alembic.
senses.sentence_zh: 蒸馏师在铜制蒸馏器中加热液体。

etymology_story.zh: 经法语及中世纪拉丁语传入英语，源自阿拉伯语 al-anbīq，其中 al- 是定冠词，而 anbīq 可追溯至希腊语 ambix，指杯状器皿或蒸馏器的顶盖。名称由蒸馏装置的部件扩展为整套蒸馏器的名称，也可在文学中比喻提炼或转化的过程。
etymology_story.en: The word reached English through French and medieval Latin from Arabic al-anbīq, with the article al- and a noun ultimately derived from Greek ambix, a cup or still-head. The name expanded from a component to the distilling apparatus and can also figuratively suggest refinement or transformation.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 alembic 是不可再分的借入词根，不能按英语前缀 al- 加词根来分析；复数为 alembics。罕见或古旧的派生词包括 alembicate（蒸馏；提炼）及 alembication（蒸馏；提炼过程），不属于常用词族。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, alembic is an indivisible borrowed base, not an English prefix al- plus a root; its plural is alembics. Rare or archaic derivatives include alembicate, 'to distil or refine,' and alembication, 'distillation or refinement'; these are not everyday vocabulary.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: still（蒸馏器）是较通用的名称；retort（曲颈蒸馏瓶）强调瓶体及其弯曲长颈的结构；distillation apparatus（蒸馏装置）是涵盖各种现代或传统设备的技术性统称。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Still is the broader everyday name for a distilling device; retort identifies a vessel with a bent neck; distillation apparatus is a technical umbrella term covering both traditional and modern equipment.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 从古代“杯状顶盖”想到蒸汽冷凝：蒸发，再收集液滴，就是 alembic 的核心功能。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture the ancient cup-like still-head catching condensed vapour: evaporate, cool, and collect.

forms: demerges；过去式及过去分词 demerged；现在分词 demerging。
family: demerger 公司分拆；merge 合并。

morphology.text: de-（逆转） + merge（合并） → demerge（把合并的业务拆分）。

etymology.text: 英语用表示逆转的 de- 接在 merge 前形成商业用词，意思是把原来聚合的公司业务拆开。

usage_note: 商业用语，可及物或不及物，常用 demerge a business 或 demerge from a group；不等于卖掉一件资产。

senses.meaning_zh: 拆分公司或业务；使分立；从集团中分拆出去
senses.meaning_en: to split a company or business into separate organizations
senses.english_definition: If a company demerges, or demerges part of its business, it separates into independent companies or makes that business independent.
senses.collocation_en: demerge a business; demerge from a parent company
senses.collocation_zh: 分拆一项业务；从母公司分拆出去
senses.sentence_en: The group plans to demerge its retail business next year.
senses.sentence_zh: 该集团计划明年将零售业务分拆出去。

etymology_story.zh: 由表示逆转的前缀 de- 与 merge“合并”组合而成，在现代商业英语中表示撤销合并或把集团业务拆分。merge 更早可追溯至拉丁语 mergere“浸入、淹没”，后来发展出“融为一体”的意义。
etymology_story.en: Demerge combines the reversative prefix de- with merge and developed in modern business English for undoing a merger or separating group businesses. Merge ultimately comes from Latin mergere, 'to dip or immerse,' which later developed the sense of combining into one.

morphology_enriched.zh: de-（逆转）+ merge（合并）→ demerge（分拆），可作及物或不及物动词。屈折形式为 demerges、demerged、demerging；相关名词为 demerger（公司分拆），对应基础词族包括 merge、merger（合并）和 merging（合并过程）。
morphology_enriched.en: De- 'reverse' + merge 'combine' forms demerge, used both transitively and intransitively. Inflected forms are demerges, demerged, and demerging; the related noun is demerger, and the underlying family includes merge, merger, and merging.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: split up（拆分）适用范围最广，不限于公司；spin off（分拆成立独立公司）强调从现有企业中分离出一个业务实体；divest（出售或处置资产、业务）强调放弃所有权，不一定通过公司分立完成。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Split up is broad and need not concern companies; spin off emphasizes creating an independent business from an existing one; divest emphasizes disposing of ownership and does not necessarily involve a corporate separation.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: merge 是“合起来”，de- 把动作逆转：demerge 就是“拆开来”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Merge joins businesses; de- reverses the action, so demerge separates them.

senses.meaning_zh: 灰雁，一种大型灰褐色野雁
senses.meaning_en: a large grey-brown wild goose of the species Anser anser
senses.english_definition: A greylag is a large wild goose with grey-brown feathers that belongs to the species from which many domestic geese descend.
senses.collocation_en: a greylag goose; a flock of greylags
senses.collocation_zh: 一只灰雁；一群灰雁

etymology_story.zh: greylag 由 grey“灰色”与 lag 构成，但第二部分的确切来源并不确定。一种传统解释把它与 lag“迟留、落后”联系起来，认为名称指这种雁比其他雁类更晚离开繁殖地；这一解释不宜当作已证实的词源。
etymology_story.en: Greylag combines grey with lag, but the precise origin of the second element is uncertain. A traditional explanation connects it with lag 'remain behind,' referring to the bird staying later than other geese, but this explanation is not established.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代形式可识别为 grey + lag 的复合词，但 lag 在此处的历史意义有争议；复数为 greylags。常见完整名称为 greylag goose，复数为 greylag geese；美国英语拼写为 graylag 或 graylag goose，无常用派生形容词或动词。
morphology_enriched.en: The modern form is recognizable as the compound grey + lag, although the historical meaning of lag here is disputed; its plural is greylags. The fuller name is greylag goose, plural greylag geese; American spellings include graylag and graylag goose, with no common derived adjective or verb.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: greylag goose（灰雁）是完整的同义名称；graylag（灰雁）是美国英语拼写变体；wild goose（野雁）是范围更广的上位词，不能单独确定为灰雁这一物种。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Greylag goose is the full equivalent name; graylag is an American spelling variant; wild goose is a broader category and does not identify this particular species.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: grey 锁定灰色羽毛；把 lag 联想为“晚走一步”，仅作为记忆画面。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Grey identifies the plumage; picture a goose that lags behind as a memory aid, without treating that image as proven history.

etymology_story.zh: 这是由希腊语来源的 iso-（相等）和 pachys（厚）构成的地质学术语。其名称直接描述了用途：把同一地层厚度相等的地点连接起来。
etymology_story.en: This geological term combines Greek-derived iso-, meaning 'equal', with an element from Greek pachys, meaning 'thick'. Its name directly describes its purpose: connecting points where a geological layer has equal thickness.

morphology_enriched.zh: 构词公式：iso-（相等）＋ pach-（厚），属于新古典构词；pach- 是黏着词根，不能独立作普通英语词。词族包括复数 isopachs，以及形容词 isopachous（等厚的）；isopach map 中的 isopach 是名词作定语。
morphology_enriched.en: Formation: iso- ('equal') + pach- ('thick'), a neoclassical formation; pach- is a bound root rather than an independent everyday English word. The family includes the plural isopachs and the adjective isopachous ('of equal thickness'); in isopach map, isopach is an attributive noun.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: equal-thickness contour（等厚线）是解释性同义表达；contour line（等值线）范围更广；isochore（等垂向厚度线）专指垂直测得的厚度相等，而 isopach 严格指垂直于层面测得的真厚度相等。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Equal-thickness contour is an explanatory equivalent; contour line is broader; isochore specifically connects equal vertical thicknesses, whereas an isopach strictly connects equal true thicknesses measured perpendicular to the layer boundaries.

mnemonic_anchor.en: Iso- means equal and pach- means thick: join the points that are equally thick.

etymology_story.zh: 这个词由 make 和 weight 合成，原指为了达到规定重量而补加的东西。后来其含义扩展到为凑足人数、篇幅或交易条件而加入的人或物。
etymology_story.en: The compound combines make and weight and originally referred to something added to reach a required weight. Its meaning later extended to people or things included to complete numbers, fill space, or round out a deal.

morphology_enriched.zh: 构词公式：make（使达到）＋ weight（重量）→ makeweight（使重量达标的补充物）。这是动词＋名词构成的复合名词；复数为 makeweights，没有常用的派生动词或形容词。
morphology_enriched.en: Formation: make ('bring up to a required amount') + weight → makeweight ('an addition that completes the weight'). It is a verb–noun compound functioning as a noun; its plural is makeweights, and it has no established common derived verb or adjective.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: filler（填充物、充数内容）强调填补空缺；stopgap（临时替代者或措施）强调暂时应急；bargaining chip（谈判筹码）强调交换价值。makeweight 强调主要为补足整体而加入，自身通常处于次要地位。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Filler emphasizes filling empty space; stopgap emphasizes a temporary substitute; bargaining chip emphasizes negotiating value. Makeweight emphasizes an addition whose main role is to complete the whole and whose own importance is usually secondary.

mnemonic_anchor.en: Make the weight: first complete the weight, then complete the numbers.

etymology_story.zh: 这个英语鱼名传统上分析为 rock（岩石）加名词后缀 -ling。名称把这种鱼与岩石环境联系起来，但它实际上可以指多种生活在不同海底环境中的鳕形鱼。

morphology_enriched.zh: 构词公式：rock（岩石）＋ -ling（表示小型者或某类生物的名词后缀）→ rockling。复数为 rocklings；没有常用的派生动词或形容词。three-bearded rockling、five-bearded rockling 等是具体鱼类名称。

synonyms_and_nuances.en: Cod names related fish and is not freely interchangeable with rockling; ling usually refers to a different, larger cod-like fish; cod-like fish is only a broad description. These are related terms rather than exact synonyms.

mnemonic_anchor.en: Rock + -ling: picture a small, whiskered sea fish beside a rock.

etymology_story.zh: 这个词来自新拉丁语 abomasum，由 ab-（离开、从……）和拉丁语 omasum（牛胃的一部分）构成。它成为反刍动物第四胃室的解剖学名称；位于瓣胃之后是其解剖位置，不能直接把 ab- 解释成“之后”。
etymology_story.en: The word comes from New Latin abomasum, formed from ab- ('away from' or 'from') and Latin omasum, a term for part of an ox's stomach. It became the anatomical name for the fourth stomach compartment; its position after the omasum does not mean that ab- literally means 'after'.

morphology_enriched.zh: 术语结构：ab-＋ omasum；在现代普通英语中，通常将 abomasum 作为完整的专业名词学习。复数为 abomasa，也可用 abomasums；相关词包括 abomasal（皱胃的）、abomasitis（皱胃炎）、abomasotomy（皱胃切开术）和 abomasopexy（皱胃固定术）。
morphology_enriched.en: Technical structure: ab- + omasum; in ordinary modern English, abomasum is generally learned as a complete specialist noun. Its plurals are abomasa and, alternatively, abomasums; related formations include abomasal ('relating to the abomasum'), abomasitis ('inflammation of the abomasum'), abomasotomy ('surgical incision into the abomasum'), and abomasopexy ('surgical fixation of the abomasum').

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: fourth stomach（第四胃）强调顺序；true stomach（真胃）强调其分泌胃液的功能；rennet stomach（凝乳酶胃）强调其与凝乳酶来源的关系。abomasum 是最准确的解剖学术语。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Fourth stomach emphasizes its position in the sequence; true stomach emphasizes its gastric secretory function; rennet stomach emphasizes its association with the source of rennet. Abomasum is the precise anatomical term.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 位置记忆：瓣胃 omasum 后面接皱胃 abomasum；第四室分泌胃液。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Use position as the hook: omasum, then abomasum—the fourth compartment secretes gastric juices.

senses.meaning_en: The self or spiritual essence, especially in Indian philosophy.
senses.english_definition: In Indian philosophy, especially Hindu thought, atman is the inner self or spiritual essence of a person, understood differently by different traditions.

etymology_story.zh: 英语借自梵语 ātman，其早期含义包括气息、生命和自我，后来成为印度哲学中讨论内在自我的重要术语。不同传统对它的理解不同，因此不能一概把它等同于与身体分离的个体灵魂。
etymology_story.en: English borrowed Sanskrit ātman, whose earlier meanings included breath, life, and self; it later became a central term for the inner self in Indian philosophy. Traditions interpret it differently, so it cannot always be equated with an individual soul separate from the body.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中是不可再作普通英语词缀切分的借词；ātman 是保留长元音标记的转写形式，atma 是另一种常见形式。英语复数可作 atmans，但哲学讨论中常作单数或抽象概念使用；相关梵语借词 anātman／anatman（无我）由否定前缀 an- 加 ātman 构成，不是英语内部的派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, this is a borrowing without a productive English root-and-affix breakdown; ātman is a transliteration retaining the long-vowel mark, and atma is another common form. The English plural can be atmans, though philosophical discussion often uses the singular or treats it as an abstract concept; the related Sanskrit borrowing anātman/anatman ('non-self') combines negative an- with ātman and is not an English-internal derivative.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: self（自我）最宽泛；soul（灵魂）容易带入其他宗教关于灵魂的观念；ego（自我意识、自我中心）通常指心理层面的自我。atman 是特定哲学术语，其含义往往超出日常人格或自我意识。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Self is the broadest equivalent; soul may import assumptions from other religious traditions; ego usually refers to the psychological sense of personal identity or self-importance. Atman is a specific philosophical term whose meaning often extends beyond everyday personality or ego.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 从“气息、生命”想到“内在自我”；这是语义联想，不是英语拆词。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Move from breath and life to the inner self; this is a semantic association, not an English word breakdown.

etymology_story.zh: 由英式粗俗俚语动词 bollock（臭骂）加 -ing 构成。该动词与 bollocks（睾丸；胡说）有关，后者可追溯到古英语 bealluc（睾丸），但“臭骂”是后来形成的俚语义。
etymology_story.en: Bollocking was formed from the British vulgar slang verb bollock, meaning to scold, plus -ing. The verb is related to bollocks, ultimately from Old English bealluc, meaning a testicle; the scolding sense developed much later.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：bollock（臭骂）+ -ing（行为或事件名词后缀）。常见相关形式：动词 bollock、bollocks、bollocked、bollocking；名词 bollocking，复数 bollockings。bollocking 也可作 bollock 的现在分词，但这是动词屈折形式。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern formation: bollock (to scold) + -ing (an action or event noun suffix). Common related forms are the verb forms bollock, bollocks, bollocked, and bollocking, and the noun bollocking, plural bollockings. Bollocking can also be the verb's present participle, an inflectional use.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: telling-off（训斥）是较温和、非粗俗的日常表达；dressing-down（痛斥）强调严厉批评；reprimand（训诫）较正式，常涉及上级对下级的批评。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: A telling-off is an everyday, non-vulgar expression that can sound milder; a dressing-down emphasizes severe criticism; a reprimand is more formal and often comes from someone in authority.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把 bollock 记作“臭骂”，加 -ing 就是“一顿臭骂”；保留其粗俗语气。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Anchor bollock to 'scold harshly'; adding -ing turns the action into 'a severe scolding.' Remember its vulgar tone.

etymology_story.en: Characin comes from the New Latin fish name Characinus, ultimately connected with Greek kharax, meaning a pointed stake and also used as the name of a fish. English adopted the taxonomic name for this group of freshwater fishes.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中通常作为整体词干 characin 学习，不宜强拆为常用英语词根与后缀；复数为 characins。相关分类词包括 characid（脂鲤科鱼；脂鲤科的）、characinoid（脂鲤类的；脂鲤类鱼）和 characiform（脂鲤目的）；这些是相关术语，其分类范围不一定完全相同。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, characin is normally learned as a whole stem rather than divided into productive everyday roots and suffixes; its plural is characins. Related taxonomic terms include characid, characinoid, and characiform. These are related technical formations whose taxonomic scope is not necessarily identical.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: characid（脂鲤科鱼）是关系密切的分类术语，但其范围取决于分类体系；tetra（灯鱼）通常指其中较小、常见于水族箱的鱼；piranha（食人鱼）只指其中某些鱼类，不能替代整个类群名称。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Characid is a closely related taxonomic term whose scope depends on the classification used; tetra usually refers to smaller members familiar as aquarium fish; piranha names particular members and cannot replace the name of the whole group.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 从常见灯鱼联想到其所属的脂鲤类：tetra 是具体成员，characin 是类群名称。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Start with a familiar aquarium tetra: tetra names a member, while characin names the broader fish group.
